name: Branch Figurative
overview: The Branch Figurative in Scripture portrays Christ as the true vine, with believers as branches who must abide in Him to bear fruit. John 15 emphasizes that branches not producing fruit are removed, while fruitful branches are pruned to yield even more, illustrating the necessity of spiritual cleansing and dependence on Christ. This imagery also encompasses Christ’s role as a symbolic branch, highlighting both the call to fruitful living and the consequences of separation from Him.
